purpose: Test whether pre-breakout price and volatility states can rank actual trend occurrence rather than terminal profit.

input.information_boundary: the exact P0R prestate features ending at t-1; no trigger-day, symbol, asset-class, BTC, relative-strength, or future feature

label.name: barrier_success_20
label.success: within the next 20 observed sessions, close first reaches +2 ATR20[t-1] in the crossing direction before reaching -1 ATR20[t-1] against the crossing direction
label.failure_or_neutral: the -1 ATR adverse barrier is reached first, or +2 ATR is not reached within 20 sessions
label.reason: this labels whether a directional trend movement actually emerges, not whether the terminal twentieth-session return happens to be positive

features: exact ML_FEATURES tuple frozen in BIN-1D-TPSA-P0
training: expanding history; an event enters training only when its actual twentieth future session is before test start

decision_boundary.useful_state_learning_requires: AUC and top-minus-bottom occurrence spread above random in a clear majority of walk-forward years for both MA7 and MA30 within a direction; a single good year or model is insufficient
